fee_plans.description: List of fee plans matching the given query parameters.

cursor.description: The pagination cursor to be used in a subsequent request. If empty, this is the final response.

Currency.description:
Indicates the country associated with an entity. Values are from the [ISO-4217 Alpha-3](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) specification.

Current values:

- `USD`: United States Dollar
Currency.title: Currency

id.description: A unique identifier for the fee plan issued by Cash App.

status.description:
The state is used to determine whether or not this fee plan is currently in use.
- `ACTIVE`
- `DISABLED`

description.description: A free-form text field that stores information associated with the fee plan.

created_at.description: When this fee plan was created, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

updated_at.description: When this fee plan was last updated, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

FeePlan.description: The full fee plan that PSPs can use to set the buy rates for specific merchants.
FeePlan.title: FeePlan

basis_points.description: The variable fee charged for processing the payment expressed as 1/100th of a percentage.

fixed_amount.description:
The amount charged for processing the payment, in the lowest denomination of currency on the payment.
 **Note: The currency for the fee is found on the fee plan.**

FeeRate.description: A fee rate contains the components of a fee charged by Cash App to partners for a given payment.
FeeRate.title: FeeRate

Metadata.description:
Freeform key-value pairs of arbitrary data associated with this resource.

Keys and values must be passed as strings and not contain any personally identifiable information (PII).

Min keys: `0`
Max keys: `50`


> Note: Nested keys are not supported.
Metadata.title: Metadata
